card.name: www in FDA companion diagnostics links
card.fires_on: The word "www" right after http:// or https:// in FDA web addresses, mostly the companion diagnostics test-information link. It also fires weakly on other FDA-related spots like "www.fda.gov/" before medwatch.

modes.label: www in FDA test links
modes.description: The "www" at the start of the fda.gov/CompanionDiagnostics address after a sentence about FDA-approved tests.
modes.example: Information on FDA-authorized tests for detection of ESR1 mutations in breast cancer is available at: http://<<www>>.fda.gov/CompanionDiagnostics

modes.label: Other FDA name spots
modes.description: Weaker cases inside FDA-related names or addresses, such as the slash before medwatch or the end of Dermatology.
